messages:
Incident Bot: PAGED: prod-gateway — elevated 5xx + client timeouts after deploy (service: gateway, region: us-west1). Pager triggered at 10:03 UTC. Impact: increased p95/p99 latencies and ~8% error rate. @oncall please ack and triage. :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: acked. I'm oncall. seeing p95 -> 1.2s (baseline 180ms), p99 -> 4.8s. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/gateway/overview — errors are mostly 502/504 and grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.
Ashok Rao: any recent infra changes? I see a deploy at 09:58 from pipeline #deploy-4521 to gateway-prod-canary -> promoted.
Sophie Chen: saw spike in queue length at the ingress routers, plus many KV cache misses. Might be cache eviction after model switch in backends.
Maya Patel: rolling analysis: running flamegraphs, but immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback to previous gateway image (deploy-4517) 2) enable fallback routing to model-v1 for heavy routes 3) temporarily increase gateway replicas to absorb spike.
Jen Kline: customers already pinged? Support flagging any active SLO breaches?
Samir Gupta: Support: a few customers reported timeouts on embed requests. Escalation threshold hit.
Maya Patel: I'll start rollback. Command: ```sh
# rollback to previous revision
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/gateway gateway=registry.redwood/gateway:4517
kubectl rollout status deploy/gateway -n prod
```
Ops Bot: deploy rollback initiated by Maya Patel at 10:12 UTC. CI: #deploy-rollback-4521->4517.
Ashok Rao: while rollback runs, let's disable the new routing rule that fans out to model-v2 cluster. Patch ingress: ```yaml
spec:
  rules:
    - host: api.redwood.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /v1/embeddings
            backend:
              serviceName: gateway
              servicePort: 443
            # temp: remove header-based route to model-v2
```
Lucas Moreno: I'll open a trace in Lightstep for a 502 sample: trace id 0x9a7f. Looks like upstream model-v2 overloaded and returning early 504s; connection pool exhaustion on model-router.
Sophie Chen: adding a short-lived circuit-breaker on calls to model-router with lower parallelism until rollout stabilizes. Patch applied.
Maya Patel: rollback complete at 10:22 UTC. kubectl shows rollout finished, old pods healthy. Observability: p95 down to 250ms, p99 down to 600ms. Error rate trending back to baseline.
Incident Bot: NOTE: rollback successful. Monitoring will verify for 30m.
Jen Kline: great. I'm drafting a short status for customers: "We experienced elevated errors/timeouts after a recent gateway deploy. We rolled back the deploy at 10:22 UTC; service is recovering. Continued monitoring and postmortem to follow." Want me to send now?
Samir Gupta: send now to affected customers list + CS. Add note about impacted window (09:58–10:22 UTC).
Lucas Moreno: saving traces and heap profiles from the timeframe for postmortem; uploaded artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1782105610/.
Ashok Rao: follow-up tasks: - root-cause: investigate why model-v2 causes connection pool saturation - improve canary metrics for tail latency - add automation to rollback on p99 spike > 3x baseline
Sophie Chen: also add KV cache warmup step and validate cache eviction behavior in release pipeline.
Maya Patel: handing off to Ashok for deeper RCA. I'm going offline for the next hour but will be available via DM. If anything regresses, @Ops Bot please page again.
Ashok Rao: ack. Taking over incident lead. Will schedule postmortem and link timeline.
Ops Bot: Incident handover recorded: lead -> Ashok Rao at 10:30 UTC.
Maya Patel: quick note — I saw some customer requests still hitting timeouts during rollback window; will verify retries/resubmit logic in client lib after RCA.
Jen Kline: thanks team. Postmortem owner: Ashok. Communication: Jen will coordinate external comms.
Samir Gupta: closing the pager for now but keeping alerts on. If p99 > 1s again, auto-pager will trigger.
Incident Bot: Incident status: mitigated (rollback). Monitoring window active until 10:52 UTC. Postmortem ticket: PM-INC-1782105610 created."
